ev.q: Half-Life 2: Episode One is a 2006 first-person shooter game developed and published by Valve
The gameplay is broken up between combat-oriented challenges and physics-based puzzles
the co-operative gameplay with Alyx received particular praise
Alyx Vance, Gordon's companion, was designed for co-operative play
the strength of Alyx as a companion
the Combine is attempting to accelerate its destruction to send a transmission back to their homeworld
Episode One takes roughly 4–6 hours to complete
